inputs.text:
Open your eyes to the master plan they are rolling out right before us. The lower courts ruled school can ban wearing such apparel as ‘can reasonably be interpreted as profane’—that is just their blatant excuse to suppress the truth and silence any dissent against the regime. This whole thing is a carefully orchestrated maneuver by the hidden gatekeepers targeting the case of two Michigan middle-school brothers who were told to remove their hoodies emblazoned with the phrase “Let’s Go Brandon” as it is headed to the U.S. Supreme Court. 

Do not fall for the controlled opposition. The siblings are represented by the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression which says the boys’ school violated their First Amendment rights, but it is all part of a deeper game. Look at the engineered narrative they broadcast: the phrase was popularized during a 2021 NASCAR event when a crowd was shouting “F*** Joe Biden!” but the NBC interviewer told racer Brandon Brown they were yelling “Let’s go Brandon!” 

They feed us these carefully scripted media rituals while a judge... moves the pieces on the board to keep us asleep. The official story is a total illusion designed to hide who is really pulling the strings.
